title: 기술심리관규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Entries in Records)
(1) Where a technical examiner participates in the examination of a case during oral arguments or preparatory proceedings, the name of the technical examiner shall be entered in the record.
(2) Where a technical examiner questions any person involved in proceedings with permission from the presiding judge or a commissioned judge during oral arguments or preparatory proceedings, that fact shall be entered in the record.
